terminal_producers.description: The final quantity of usable blood units at St. Vincent regional hospital is produced by the starting quantity (15) plus the two scheduled shipments (150 each) that transfer units from the centre. The collection process adds units to the centre's stock, but the centre's stock is not directly observed; only the hospital's quantity matters. The hospital receives 150 units on Tuesday and 150 on Thursday, so total = 15 + 150 + 150 = 315 units.

provenance.note: Starting hospital stock plus two shipments of 150 each.

uncertainties.description: Shipment delivery time: 3 hours is inferred, but could vary. However, since shipments are sent at 4 PM and deadline is Friday noon, even with 3-hour delay, units arrive by 7 PM Tuesday and Thursday, well before deadline.
